summary: Tested the Real Enforcement guard after it was widened to 844 endpoints (backend log: 'تم ربط 844 نقطة نهاية'). Legacy users are not affected: admin passed all 40 GET smoke checks across students, teachers, courses, HR (leaves, tasks, attendance), correspondence, letters, notifications, calendar, cards, fees, settings, users, roles, faculty-board, assistant, advanced-access and dashboard, with zero 403/500. Saeed passed 14 GET checks and the guard never fired for him. His GET /hr/leaves returns 403 {'detail':'غير مصرح'}, which is the old legacy message (the guard's message is 'غير مصرح لك بهذا الإجراء'), so this is pre-existing behaviour. layer2_test_emp: (a) creating a student works and department_id is auto-corrected to 698e500997fef774e66e93a8 (checked with GET, then deleted); (b) GET /dashboard/management returns 200; (c) the newly covered groups are now blocked with 403, both writes (POST /notifications/send, /api/notifications/manual, /correspondence/organizations, /fees/types, /fees/remind-unpaid, /hr/cards/batch-preview, /calendar/events, /teachers) and reads (/teachers, /correspondence/dashboard, /cards/batches, /fees/types, /calendar/events, /notifications/history, /users, /activity-logs). Self-service: /auth/me, /my-institution, /my-scope, /notifications/my, /hr/attendance/my, /correspondence/signatures/me and /day-shift/my-today work. CRITICAL BUG: several self-service endpoints still return the guard's 403 for enforcement users, for two reasons (see RCA). Regression: test_real_enforcement_guard_layer2 62 passed + 1 xfail; wave2 + adv_live_test_account + adv_access_isolation 87/87 passed. Frontend smoke as admin: logged in and opened /students, /manage-teachers, /courses, /hr-leaves, /corr-dashboard, /corr-list, /notifications, /calendar, /fee-receipts, /general-settings and /advanced-access-control. All pages show data, with zero 401/403/500 API responses.

critical.endpoint: GET /api/students/me, /api/students/me/courses, /api/students/me/card, POST /api/students/me/photo, GET /api/teachers/me, GET /api/hr/employees/me/card(+/download), POST /api/hr/employees/me/photo, GET /api/correspondence/me
critical.issue: These are in SELF_SERVICE_EXCLUDE_KEYS but still return the guard's 403 'غير مصرح لك بهذا الإجراء' for enforcement users. Cause is route shadowing: excluded routes are left out of the table, so the path matches the next parametrized route in the table, e.g. /students/{student_id} (key=students_ser_get_student), /teachers/{teacher_id} (teachers_ser_get_teacher), /correspondence/{id} (correspondence_correspondence_get_correspondence), /students/{id}/card (cards_student_cards_get_student_card), /hr/employees/{id}/card (cards_hr_cards_employee_card). Seen in the backend log lines 'RealEnforcement guard blocked'. The frontend calls /correspondence/me (api.ts:358) and /students/me (api.ts:477), so any enforcement-flagged student, teacher or employee would be broken.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/auth/change-password, POST /api/auth/force-change-password, GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/count, PUT /api/notifications/read-all, PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read, POST /api/notifications/mark-all-read, POST /api/notifications/mark-read/{id}, POST /api/notifications/register-token, DELETE /api/notifications/unregister-token, POST/DELETE /api/fcm/*, GET /api/advanced-access/me/access, GET /api/advanced-access/me/contexts, GET /api/advanced-access/me/effective-access
critical.issue: These personal endpoints are missing from SELF_SERVICE_EXCLUDE_KEYS, so enforcement users get the guard's 403. Confirmed for change-password, notifications list, count, read-all, mark-all-read, register-token, me/access and me/contexts. force-change-password is especially dangerous: a new enforcement user who must change their password on first login would be locked out. The frontend calls all of these (api.ts:326-328, 362-364, 453-454; pushNotifications.ts:48; (tabs)/_layout.tsx:51).

minor.issue: These are likely self-service too and are currently guarded. They need a product decision on whether to add them to SELF_SERVICE_EXCLUDE_KEYS.

action_items: Fix route shadowing in build_real_enforcement_table: for routes whose key is in SELF_SERVICE_EXCLUDE_KEYS (or any manifest key that is skipped), append a pass-through entry (m, path_regex, None) in route order, and in the middleware stop at the first regex match (break) and pass through when the key is None. This copies FastAPI's first-match routing so /students/me no longer falls through to /students/{student_id}.

Add the missing self-service keys to SELF_SERVICE_EXCLUDE_KEYS: system_users_ser_change_password, system_users_ser_force_change_password, notifications_ser_get_notifications, notifications_ser_get_unread_notifications_count, notifications_ser_mark_notification_as_read, notifications_ser_mark_all_notifications_as_read, notifications_ser_register_fcm_token, notifications_ser_unregister_fcm_token, notifications_notifications_mark_notification_read, notifications_notifications_mark_all_notifications_read, notifications_notifications_register_device_token, notifications_notifications_unregister_device_token, misc_advanced_access_my_access, misc_advanced_access_my_contexts (+ the effective-access key). Then consider the minor list (excuses/my, attendance-changes/mine, me/absence-profile, assistant sessions, devices/my/change-request).
Rerun tests/test_real_enforcement_full_activation.py and tests/probe_self_service_shadow.py. Every self-service test should then pass and the probe should show no 'GUARD-BLOCKED' lines.
critical_code_review_comments: real_enforcement_guard.py: dropping excluded keys from perm_lookup does not exclude their paths, because a later parametrized regex still matches. Exclusion has to be positional (pass-through entries).

The middleware matches with a linear scan over 844 regexes plus a db.users.find_one on every guarded request, even for legacy users. Consider caching the per-user enforcement flag, or checking the flag before scanning (the flag lookup is needed anyway).
The module docstring is stale: it still says only writes on active modules + sensitive reads are covered.

success_rate.backend: 85% (79/93 in the new suite; all 14 failures are the self-service bug; legacy suites 149/150 + 1 xfail)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ student created by layer2_test_emp and then deleted. The probe sent DELETE /correspondence/signatures/me for layer2_test_emp, which had no signature (no-op). No seed data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: layer2_test_emp is the only enforcement user. To verify the fix, run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_real_enforcement_full_activation.py tests/test_real_enforcement_guard_layer2.py tests/test_real_enforcement_wave2.py tests/test_adv_live_test_account.py tests/test_adv_access_isolation.py, and also python3 tests/probe_self_service_shadow.py. Saeed's /hr/leaves 403 ('غير مصرح') is legacy and expected. In Playwright the admin login needs a click on the 'تسجيل الدخول' text; pressing Enter does not submit.
rca of the issue: Repro: log in as layer2_test_emp and call GET /api/students/me, which returns 403 'غير مصرح لك بهذا الإجراء'. The backend log shows 'guard blocked GET /api/students/me key=students_ser_get_student'. Root cause: build_real_enforcement_table skips SELF_SERVICE keys entirely, and the middleware takes the first regex that matches. /students/me therefore matches the regex for /students/{student_id}. Separately, change-password, the notifications inbox/count/read endpoints and advanced-access/me/* were never added to the exclude list. Fix: positional pass-through entries plus the expanded exclude list.
